name: Kasahara - The Cafe
specialty_dish: Filter coffee and cinnamon toast on the open verandah
notes: Order the filter coffee and a slice of cake and sit on the open verandah — named for the Japanese artisan Kimtaro Kasahara, the menu is deliberately simple. Best as a between-museums break, not a full meal.

name: Ghore Baire Restaurant
specialty_dish: Bhetki paturi and Sunday Bengali thali
notes: Order the bhetki paturi or the Sunday thali; named after Tagore's novel. Honest home-style Bengali in a simple AC room — not a destination restaurant, but the most reliable sit-down meal in town.

name: Bhojohori Manna
area: Hill Cart Road, 2nd floor Hotel Golden Moments
notes: Go for daab chingri or shorshe ilish — the Kolkata chain's transit-town outpost is the most reliable Bengali fish curry on the route. Plain dining room, busy at lunch with NJP-bound travellers.

name: Tora Eco Resort Kitchen
notes: Order the crab masala and bhetki paturi — the kitchen sources from local Bali Island fishermen and the menu shifts with the catch. Resort-only kitchen so you must be staying or pre-arrange a meal stop.

name: Sundarban Tiger Camp Restaurant
notes: Hilsa in mustard gravy when in season (Jul-Sep), otherwise stick to the chingri malai curry. Resort dining room serves a fixed lunch buffet to package guests; standalone meals possible on prior request.

name: Sundarini Naturals (honey + co-op produce)
specialty_dish: Wild forest honey from Mouli collectors
notes: Buy the wild forest honey direct from the Mouli collectors' co-op — the only honest provenance for Sundarbans honey, every other label downstream is questionable. Not a restaurant but the one packaged-goods stop worth making.
